name: 7441-longdecode-dsv2lite-tp4
model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat. Ungated on the Hub, ~31 GB of bf16 weights, needs trust-remote-code.
parallelism: tp4. Tensor parallel only -- no pipeline, expert or data parallelism.
architecture: DeepseekV2ForCausalLM: 27 layers, MLA attention, MoE from layer 1, 15.7B total / 2.4B active, bf16.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, warmup the first 15%, bounded at 400 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn: prompts 512 +- 128 (clamped 128-1024), generations 1024 +- 128 (clamped 512-1536). Seed 42.
purpose: A long-form writing assistant drafting thousand-token replies from short prompts for eight concurrent users on four GPUs.
launch:
# sglang at commit 5962e70d8d37a312ee93eec79f91146a929b30d7 (`git describe --tags` =
# v0.4.7.post1-71-g5962e70d8d3), four H100s on one node, eight concurrent clients.

model-path: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat

# The checkpoint ships its own configuration and modeling modules and its tokenizer needs them.
trust-remote-code: true

tp-size: 4

# Pinned rather than left to auto-select, so the attention implementation cannot resolve
# differently out of the environment.
attention-backend: fa3

disable-radix-cache: true

# The checkpoint's native window before YaRN. LOAD-BEARING: the checkpoint advertises 163840
# positions and the device-side request table does not fit at that width.
context-length: 4096

mem-fraction-static: 0.85
random-seed: 42
